title: Inception
text: Inception is a science fiction heist film about a thief who steals secrets by entering people's dreams. A team plants an idea in a corporate heir's mind through layered dream levels. The spinning top totem leaves the ending ambiguous.

title: Arrival
text: Arrival follows a linguist recruited by the military to communicate with aliens whose ships appear across Earth. Learning their circular language changes how she perceives time. The film treats language as a way of reshaping thought.

title: Parasite
text: Parasite is a dark comedy thriller about a poor family that infiltrates a wealthy household by posing as skilled workers. Class tension builds from a basement secret toward a violent birthday gathering.

title: The city will not cool overnight
text: A newspaper column on a record heat wave. Asphalt holds the day's temperature after sunset. The writer argues that shade trees and night buses matter more than another cooling-center press release.

title: Who needs a library after six
text: The city cut weekday library hours. Students lose a quiet desk and a printer. The column says public rooms are infrastructure, not a luxury for people who already own a study.

title: A strike measured in missed shifts
text: Bus drivers walked out over unpaid overtime. Commuters describe two-hour crossings and lost restaurant shifts. The column asks why the city budget can fund a stadium before a contract.

title: Keeper
text: A short story about a lighthouse keeper who starts leaving the lamp unlit on foggy nights. Fishermen still find the rocks. He writes letters to a sister who never answers and counts ships that do not come.

title: Tuesday stall
text: A fruit seller in a covered market pretends not to notice a boy stealing oranges. Each Tuesday she leaves one bruised orange at the edge of the crate. Winter comes and the boy stops arriving.

title: Last seat
text: On a night train a woman recognizes the stranger opposite her from a wedding years ago. They do not speak. Stations pass like unused sentences. At dawn she leaves the scarf he forgot on the seat.

title: JWT authentication
text: JWT authentication allows a server to issue a signed token after login. The client sends the token on later requests. The server verifies the signature instead of storing session state. Expired tokens must be rejected.

title: Why documents are chunked
text: Embedding an entire document into one vector averages out its meaning. Retrieval works better when text is split into overlapping chunks so a search hit points at a paragraph, not a whole essay.

title: Qdrant payload indexes
text: Qdrant stores vectors and a JSON payload per point. Keyword indexes on documentId and source make filtered search cheap. Without a payload index a filter scans every point.
